_readme: Tier-1 reskins for the highest-weight MKT, OPS and RIV events that ship as
industries: "all" and carried no rewrite in industry/reskins.json.
Same contract as that file: keyed by event id, then by industry code, and each
string replaces GameEvent.text wholesale. Every rule in reskins.json's _readme
binds here unchanged — the situation means the same thing in all twelve, the
choices are shared and untouched, and every figure the choices lean on survives
verbatim (E-RIV-002's 20%, E-RIV-003's 40%, E-OPS-014's −30% and nine humans,
DELIBERATELY ABSENT, though they outweigh two events that are here:
E-MKT-002 — the budget is three 2S doors and the choice labels are the doors.
E-MKT-005 — the 0.5S ask is repeated in all three known chips.
Reskinning either means restating its number in twelve sentences that then can
never be revised independently of the choices. Same call the base file made.
WHAT EACH SET IS FOR: the mechanic is fixed, so the reskin is the whole lesson.
E-OPS-013's counterfeits teach ingredient safety in PET, chargebacks in GAMING
and certification fraud in SUSTAIN off one identical set of three choices.

E-MKT-001.FOOD: A customer films themselves putting your sauce on ice cream. It works. 2M views overnight.
E-MKT-001.ECOM: Someone posts your packaging rebuilt into a cat bed. 2M views overnight, and none of them mention the product.
E-MKT-001.TECH: A customer posts your scheduling tool running a wedding. You did not build it for that. 2M views overnight.
E-MKT-001.CONTENT: Ninety seconds of yours, cut out of context, is on every feed. 2M views overnight.
E-MKT-001.FASHION: Someone wears your jacket backwards on purpose. 2M views overnight, and the comments agree it is better that way.
E-MKT-001.GAMING: A player finds a way to break your physics and posts it. 2M views overnight, all of them laughing.
E-MKT-001.FITNESS: A member posts themselves using your rig for something it was not designed for. 2M views overnight, and nobody in the video is warmed up.
E-MKT-001.BEAUTY: Someone uses your primer as a nail base and posts the result. 2M views overnight, and it is a better ad than your ads.
E-MKT-001.EDTECH: A class films themselves using your app to run a mock trial you never wrote. 2M views overnight.
E-MKT-001.SUSTAIN: Someone posts your refill pouch surviving a week of camping as a water carrier. 2M views overnight.
E-MKT-001.TOYS: A video of adults playing your children's game, competitively, at 1am. 2M views overnight.
E-MKT-001.PET: A video of a dog opening your tub by itself. 2M views overnight, and half the comments call it a design flaw.

E-MKT-006.FOOD: Nobody walks in without a voucher anymore. Tuesday at full price is empty.

E-MKT-006.CONTENT: Nobody joins the membership except during a launch sale. The weeks between are dead.
E-MKT-006.FASHION: The season sells through at markdown or it does not sell through. Full-price weeks are dead.
E-MKT-006.GAMING: Nobody buys at launch price anymore. They add it to a wishlist and wait for the sale.
E-MKT-006.FITNESS: Nobody signs up outside January and the free-month offer. Full-price months are dead.
E-MKT-006.BEAUTY: Customers stockpile during the sale and buy nothing between. Full-price weeks are dead.
E-MKT-006.EDTECH: Districts have learned to sign at the end of the budget year, at a discount. Full-price terms are dead.
E-MKT-006.SUSTAIN: Customers wait for the promo, then buy three at once and store them. Full-price weeks are dead.
E-MKT-006.TOYS: Stockists only reorder on promotional terms now. Full-price weeks are dead.
E-MKT-006.PET: Subscribers cancel, take the win-back offer, and cancel again. Full-price months are dead.

E-OPS-012.FOOD: You over-ordered. The dry store is full and the dated stock is at the front.
E-OPS-012.ECOM: You over-ordered. Your fulfilment center bills by the pallet-month and is happy to keep billing.
E-OPS-012.TECH: You over-ordered the hardware. It sits in a rented unit depreciating exactly on schedule.
E-OPS-012.CONTENT: You over-ordered merch on the strength of one good month. The garage is full of it.
E-OPS-012.FASHION: You over-cut the season. The stockroom is full and the next drop needs the space.
E-OPS-012.GAMING: You over-printed the physical edition. The warehouse bills monthly and the game is a year old.
E-OPS-012.FITNESS: You over-ordered equipment for a second floor you never opened. It is in storage, insured, idle.
E-OPS-012.BEAUTY: You over-produced. Half the batch expires before the sell-through curve reaches it.
E-OPS-012.EDTECH: You over-printed the workbooks. The syllabus changes next term.
E-OPS-012.SUSTAIN: You over-ordered. Storage is eating margin, and writing it off is the exact waste you sell against.
E-OPS-012.TOYS: You over-ordered for a holiday that is now over. Storage is eating margin until the next one.
E-OPS-012.PET: You over-ordered. The best-before dates are closer than the sell-through curve.

E-OPS-013.PET: Fakes of your formula are on marketplaces at half price, and the ingredient panel is a photocopy of yours.
